authors: Anna Bárdits, Anna Adamecz, Márta Bisztray, Andrea Weber, Ágnes Szabó-Morvai

abstract: We study fertility responses to employment shocks using unique Hungarian administrative data linking firm-level mass layoff and closure events to individual-level birth and abortion records. We show that the main fertility response occurs in anticipation and differs by shock type. The number of conceptions leading to births increases in the year preceding a mass layoff (when maternal employment protection is available), but not before a firm closure (without employment protection). We interpret this result as evidence of anticipatory fertility behavior: women tend to schedule childbirth when job loss can be avoided.
abstract_zh: 我们利用匈牙利独特的行政数据，将企业层面的大规模裁员和关闭事件与个人层面的生育及堕胎记录相链接，研究就业冲击对生育率的影响。结果显示，主要的生育反应发生在预期阶段，且因冲击类型而异。在大规模裁员前一年（当母亲享有就业保护时），导致生育的受孕数量有所增加，但在企业关闭前（无就业保护时）则无此现象。我们将此结果解释为预期性生育行为的证据：女性倾向于在能够避免失业时安排生育。

abstract: How can middle-income economies convert trade openness and productivity-enhancing reforms into higher real income and welfare? This paper develops a quantitative trade model with input-output linkages and labor market frictions to assess the impact of trade and productivity reforms on real income, wages, trade, and production. Thailand and ASEAN provide a useful case because the region spans economies with very different approaches to growth: some deeply embedded in Asian manufacturing value chains, others focused on commodities, export-led industrializers, and countries pursuing more selective integration. This variation allows assessing when openness yields large welfare gains, when productivity reforms matter more, and when the two are complementary. The results show that openness gains depend on domestic capabilities, while productivity gains depend on access to inputs and markets. The policy implication is a twin agenda: reduce trade frictions in connectivity, customs, logistics, standards, certification, and regulatory recognition, while strengthening firm productivity, supplier capabilities, and manufacturing-related services in high-growth sectors and global value chains.
abstract_zh: 中等收入经济体如何将贸易开放与生产率提升型改革转化为更高的实际收入和福利？本文构建了一个包含投入产出关联与劳动力市场摩擦的量化贸易模型，用以评估贸易及生产率改革对实际收入、工资、贸易和生产的影响。泰国与东盟提供了一个有益案例，因为该区域涵盖了增长路径迥异的经济体：有的深度嵌入亚洲制造业价值链，有的侧重于大宗商品，有的走出口导向型工业化道路，还有的则推行更具选择性的融入策略。这种差异性使得我们能够评估在何种情况下开放能带来显著的福利收益，在何种情况下生产率改革更为关键，以及何时两者具有互补性。研究结果表明，开放收益取决于国内能力，而生产率收益则依赖于对投入品和市场的获取。政策启示在于双管齐下的议程：一方面减少在互联互通、海关、物流、标准、认证及监管互认方面的贸易壁垒，另一方面在高增长行业和全球价值链中强化企业生产率、供应商能力及制造业相关服务。

abstract: The source of aging matters for the real-rate redistribution channel of monetary transmission in a three-generation life-cycle model. A given old-age dependency ratio can reflect higher longevity or a lower birth rate. We show that this channel depends on the source of aging and on who bears the fiscal cost, not on the ratio alone. When retirees bear a sufficiently large share of the fiscal cost, the low-birth-rate economy has the larger consumption response to a real interest-rate increase. Otherwise, the high-longevity economy has the larger response.
abstract_zh: 在代际生命周期模型中，老龄化来源对货币传导的实际利率再分配渠道至关重要。给定的老年抚养比可能反映更高的寿命或更低的出生率。我们证明，这一渠道取决于老龄化的来源以及谁承担财政成本，而非仅取决于该比率。当退休人员承担足够大的财政成本份额时，低出生率经济体对实际利率上升的消费反应更大。否则，高寿命经济体的反应更大。

official: 官方在线 2026-05-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We characterize strategic investments in supply chain resilience when facing endogenously generated supply disruptions by an adversarial foreign rival in a geopolitical duopoly. The resilience investment has a strategic deterrence effect on rival investments in disruption. However, the domestic firm has insufficient incentives to invest in supply chain resilience, thereby justifying a subsidy policy. We characterize the optimal subsidy policy and show that it depends on the effectiveness of the interference technology available to the rival in the autocratic country if this interference operates through the market channel but not if it operates through the cost channel.
abstract_zh: 我们刻画了在地缘政治双头垄断中，面对由敌对外国对手内生生成的供应中断时，供应链韧性的战略投资特征。韧性投资对对手的中断投资具有战略威慑效应。然而，国内企业在供应链韧性投资上的激励不足，从而为补贴政策提供了合理性。我们刻画了最优补贴政策，并表明其取决于专制国家对手可用的干扰技术的有效性——若该干扰通过市场渠道运作则相关，但若通过成本渠道运作则无关。

title: Legitimate Decision Authority and Motivation in Organizations

title_primary: 组织中的合法决策权威与动机
title_secondary: Legitimate Decision Authority and Motivation in Organizations

abstract: The allocation of decision rights—and the decision hierarchies it creates—shape incentives in organizations and thus individual motivation. We study whether the motivational effects of decision hierarchies go beyond pecuniary incentives and how they relate to the perceived legitimacy of the decision hierarchy. In a laboratory experiment, we exogenously manipulate the payoff structure of an organization in a way that leaves the pecuniary incentives of all involved parties unaffected but shifts subordinates’ perceived legitimacy of the decision hierarchy. Our data show that subordinates’ motivation to provide effort is causally affected by the organizational payoff structure, and significantly associated with the perceived legitimacy of the decision hierarchy.
abstract_zh: 决策权的分配——以及由此产生的决策层级——塑造了组织中的激励机制，进而影响个体的动机。我们研究决策层级的激励效应是否超越金钱激励，以及这些效应如何与决策层级的感知合法性相关联。在一项实验室实验中，我们外生地操纵组织的报酬结构，使得所有相关方的金钱激励保持不变，但改变了下属对决策层级感知合法性的态度。数据显示，下属提供努力的动机受到组织报酬结构的因果影响，并与决策层级的感知合法性显著相关。

title: Monetary Policy Surprises with Imperfect Information
title_zh: 不完全信息下的货币政策意外
title_primary: 不完全信息下的货币政策意外
title_secondary: Monetary Policy Surprises with Imperfect Information
official: 官方在线 2025-02-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: High-frequency interest rate surprises around Fed announcements do not identify monetary policy (MP) shocks if markets are imperfectly informed. Instead, they can also reflect central bank information (CBI) shocks, when the Fed assesses the economy differently, and Fed-response-to-news (FRN) shocks, when markets misperceive the policy rule. The literature treats these as competing explanations; we show they are distinct, and jointly identify all three from the co-movement of interest rate and equity surprises, their predictability from public news, and heteroskedasticity between FOMC and non-FOMC communication. CBI effects are robust at daily and monthly frequencies; FRN matters only daily. Purging both strengthens monetary policy estimates.
abstract_zh: 美联储公告周围的高频利率意外，在市场信息不完全的情况下，并不能识别货币政策（MP）冲击。相反，它们还可能反映中央银行信息（CBI）冲击，即当美联储对经济状况评估不同时，以及市场对政策规则误解时的美联储对新闻反应（FRN）冲击。文献将这些视为竞争性解释；我们表明它们是截然不同的，并通过利率与股票意外的共同变动、它们对公共新闻的可预测性以及FOMC与非FOMC沟通之间的异方差性，联合识别出所有三种冲击。CBI效应在日度和月度频率上均稳健；FRN仅在日度频率上起作用。剔除这两种效应后，货币政策估计得到加强。

abstract: China is the world’s second-largest economy, and its monetary policy can affect global demand and trade. Using granular mutual fund data, this column finds that country stock indices and firm-level stocks with greater exposure to Chinese mutual funds experience significantly lower returns than those with less exposure following contractionary Chinese monetary policy announcements. These responses can be explained by a portfolio rebalancing channel and appear to be driven by retail investors. Overall, the findings show that China’s private portfolio equity flows already exert an influence on global equity markets, and this channel is likely to strengthen in the future.
abstract_zh: 中国作为全球第二大经济体，其货币政策能够影响全球需求与贸易。利用细粒度共同基金数据，本专栏发现，在中国紧缩性货币政策公告后，相较于敞口较小的国家股指和公司层面股票，那些对中国共同基金敞口较大的股票指数及个股回报率显著更低。这些反应可通过投资组合再平衡渠道解释，且似乎主要由散户投资者驱动。总体而言，研究结果表明，中国的私人投资组合股权流动已对全球股票市场产生影响，且这一渠道未来可能进一步加强。

title: Seemingly anchored inflation expectations
title_zh: 看似锚定的通胀预期
title_primary: 看似锚定的通胀预期
title_secondary: Seemingly anchored inflation expectations
official: 官方在线 2026-08-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Empirical evidence commonly cited as indicating that inflation expectations have become better anchored includes the declining sensitivity of expectations to inflation surprises over time, particularly around the adoption of inflation targeting. These patterns are typically attributed to the influence of explicit or implicit inflation targets on inflation expectations. We show that this evidence is consistent with a model of experience-based learning in which individuals learn solely from their life-time history of realized inflation, without anchoring their expectations to an announced inflation target. In this model, the prolonged experience of low short-run inflation persistence in the pre-COVID decades renders long-run expectations insensitive to inflation surprises, matching the patterns observed in empirical anchoring tests. A unique prediction of the experience-based learning model is also borne out in the data: the decline in surprise sensitivity since the 1980s is strongest among younger individuals. The memory of low inflation persistence experiences further explains why long-run inflation expectations remained stable in the face of the post-COVID inflation surge. At the same time, simulations indicate that the sensitivity of long-run expectations to inflation surprises would rise sharply if individuals were to experience another sustained episode of highly persistent inflation. Overall, long-run inflation expectations may be less firmly anchored than commonly believed.
abstract_zh: 通常被引用的实证证据表明，通胀预期已更好地锚定，包括预期对通胀意外事件的敏感性随时间下降，特别是在采纳通胀目标制前后。这些模式通常被归因于明确或隐含的通胀目标对通胀预期的影响。我们证明，这一证据与一种基于经验的学习模型相符，在该模型中，个体仅从自身一生经历的实际通胀历史中学习，而不将其预期锚定于公布的通胀目标。在此模型中，新冠疫情前几十年间长期存在的低短期通胀持续性经验，使得长期预期对通胀意外事件不敏感，与实证锚定测试中观察到的模式相匹配。基于经验的学习模型的一个独特预测也在数据中得到验证：自1980年代以来，意外事件敏感性的下降在年轻个体中最为显著。对低通胀持续性经验的记忆进一步解释了为何长期通胀预期在新冠疫情后通胀飙升面前保持稳定。同时，模拟表明，如果个体再次经历持续的高通胀时期，长期预期对通胀意外事件的敏感性将急剧上升。总体而言，长期通胀预期的锚定程度可能比普遍认为的要弱。

title: Climate Change and Agricultural Adaptations: Insights from Iran on Crop Choices and Irrigation Shifts

title_primary: 气候变化与农业适应：来自伊朗作物选择与灌溉转变的启示
title_secondary: Climate Change and Agricultural Adaptations: Insights from Iran on Crop Choices and Irrigation Shifts
official: 官方在线 2026-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Agriculture in the Middle East faces severe climate risks, including rising temperatures, declining precipitation, and more frequent extremes. This paper examines long‐run adaptation in Iran using farmland rental prices to capture overall productivity impacts. By combining cross‐sectional and panel models, we distinguish short‐run weather effects from long‐run climate responses and quantify adaptation benefits. While hotter and arid regions experience losses of −5.3% to −41.8% without adaptation, long‐run adjustments generate gains of 11.7%–15.2%, depending on climate scenarios. Farmers primarily adapt by shifting irrigation sources toward deep wells and reallocating acreage to heat‐tolerant crops. Beyond estimating the overall value of adaptation, we examine how climate change shapes these major adaptation practices, highlighting sustainability concerns, including groundwater depletion and distributional impacts in resource‐constrained, developing‐country settings. Our findings link long‐run climate responses to both productivity gains and sustainability trade‐offs.
abstract_zh: 中东地区的农业面临严峻的气候风险，包括气温上升、降水减少以及极端天气事件频发。本文利用农田租赁价格来捕捉整体生产力影响，研究伊朗的长期适应情况。通过结合横截面模型与面板模型，我们区分了短期天气效应与长期气候响应，并量化了适应带来的收益。尽管在无适应情况下，更炎热和干旱地区遭受的损失介于-5.3%至-41.8%之间，但长期调整带来的收益在11.7%至15.2%之间，具体取决于气候情景。农民主要通过将灌溉水源转向深井以及将种植面积重新分配至耐热作物来进行适应。除了估算适应的总体价值外，我们还考察了气候变化如何塑造这些主要适应实践，强调了资源受限的发展中国家背景下的可持续性关切，包括地下水枯竭和分配影响。我们的研究将长期气候响应与生产力提升及可持续性权衡联系起来。

title: Loosen the ties that bind: interprovincial circuit tribunals, political interference, and judicial independence
title_zh: 松绑束缚：跨省巡回法庭、政治干预与司法独立

authors: Yimeng Zhang, Go Yano, Maho Shiraishi, Gang Xu
official: 官方在线 2026-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates the effect of a major judicial reform—the establishment of interprovincial circuit tribunals (ICTs)—on politically biased court outcomes. Using a unique data set of commercial civil cases involving listed firms in China and based on a difference-in-differences approach, we find that the ICTs effectively curb political favoritism in the judiciary, as evidenced by a significant decline in the win-rate disparity between politically connected and unconnected firms following the reform. The effects are more pronounced for firms connected to higher-ranking officials, those facing higher travel costs to appeal for retrial pre-reform, cases involving larger monetary stakes, and regions characterized by weaker legal environments. Moreover, the mechanism analysis suggests that the reform reshapes local courts’ incentives to yield to political interference through career concerns and the special petition mechanism. Finally, further analysis indicates that this judicial reform improves the quality of court decisions, enhances judicial accessibility, and mitigates local protectionism. Overall, the ICTs have significantly deterred political interference in court proceedings and contributed to a more impartial judicial environment in China.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了一项重大司法改革——设立跨省巡回法庭（ICTs）——对政治偏颇的法院裁决结果的影响。利用涉及中国上市公司的商业民事案件独特数据集，并基于双重差分法，我们发现巡回法庭有效遏制了司法体系中的政治偏袒，这体现在改革后政治关联企业与非关联企业之间胜诉率差距显著缩小。这一效应在涉及更高级别官员关联的企业、改革前上诉再审旅行成本较高的企业、涉案金额较大的案件以及法治环境较弱的地区中更为显著。此外，机制分析表明，该改革通过职业顾虑和特殊信访机制重塑了地方法院屈服于政治干预的动机。最后，进一步分析显示，此项司法改革提升了法院裁决质量，增强了司法可及性，并缓解了地方保护主义。总体而言，巡回法庭显著遏制了法院程序中的政治干预，为中国更加公正的司法环境做出了贡献。

title: The Return of the Nirvana Fallacy: A Review of John Cassidy’s Capitalism and Its Critics
title_zh: 涅槃谬论的回归：评约翰·卡西迪的《资本主义及其批评者》
title_primary: 涅槃谬论的回归：评约翰·卡西迪的《资本主义及其批评者》
title_secondary: The Return of the Nirvana Fallacy: A Review of John Cassidy’s Capitalism and Its Critics
authors: Costa, Dora L., Kahn, Matthew E.
official: 来源期次 Journal of Economic Literature · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: John Cassidy's Capitalism and Its Critics surveys 250 years of capitalism's history through the eyes of roughly thirty critics, from the Luddites, early utopians and Marx to modern communitarians, antigrowth proponents, free trade opponents, and scholars of inequality. The result is a vivid, sympathetic reconstruction of left-of-center dissent. We argue, however, that the book reproduces two analytical weaknesses shared by the critics it profiles. First, it commits Harold Demsetz's Nirvana Fallacy, evaluating imperfect real-world markets against idealized regulatory alternatives rather than against equally imperfect real-world governments. Second, it underestimates capitalism's most distinctive self-correcting mechanisms: endogenous technological change and entrepreneurial creative destruction, all coordinated by the price system. The result is a catalogue of capitalism's failures unaccompanied by any comparable accounting of the alternatives.

abstract: As demand for critical minerals accelerates with the energy transition, artisanal and small-scale mining (ASM) has emerged as a key but poorly understood source of supply. We construct the first continental-scale panel of mining activity in Sub-Saharan Africa by applying supervised deep-learning methods to satellite imagery, identifying over 50,000 mining sites across 39 countries and reconstructing monthly activity from 2000 to 2019. We document three main findings. First, mining location follows strong market-access gradients with pronounced non-linearities: proximity to ports raises mining probability within 200 km, but this premium reverses at intermediate distances and re-emerges only in the most remote areas -- consistent with distance from urban centers proxying for weaker state reach and lower monitoring of informal activity. Second, entry responds rapidly to commodity price shocks, indicating that ASM operates as an elastic margin of mineral supply; over time, however, its relationship with industrial mining shifts from complementarity to a reallocation of artisanal activity away from industrial sites. Third, agricultural shocks induce entry into ASM, but spatial labor mobility attenuates local responses, pointing to strong congestion effects. Together, these results position ASM as a central yet spatially constrained adjustment margin in global critical mineral supply.

abstract: Individuals may fail to recall and use information they already know when making decisions. We empirically investigate whether such "retrieval failures" distort consumption smoothing behavior among Zambian farmers, who derive their income from one annual harvest and then spend it down over the course of the year. We document that individuals underestimate upcoming spending by 50%, creating scope for under-saving. In order to improve recall, we randomize an intervention that prompts individuals to think through their future expenses associatively in categories---without providing any external information or guidance. Treated individuals increase "remembered" expenses by 36-60%; as predicted by the memory literature, effects are concentrated among small, irregular, and stochastic items. Immediate spending drops and, six weeks after the intervention, treated households hold 15% higher savings. They subsequently enter the hungry season---the final months of the year when consumption typically declines sharply---with one additional month of savings, leading to a flatter spending profile over the year. Households use the increased savings to self-finance additional farm investment, resulting in a 9% increase in the next year's crop revenue. We replicate the intervention's impact on beliefs among low-income Americans, suggesting that retrieval failures generalize across settings and populations.

abstract: Government securities-backed repo markets constitute a key funding source for market participants in many jurisdictions. A number of recent stress episodes, e.g., in US and UK repo markets, has led to renewed efforts to strengthen the resilience of repo markets. This notably includes a push to increased central clearing via central counterparties (CCPs) which may come via market incentives or in the form of mandatory clearing. Central clearing is commonly considered as a key tool to increase transparency and understanding of markets and improve the risk management practices of market participants. This paper provides a brief overview of post trade-arrangements in select government securities repo markets and offers a structured analysis of potential benefits and risks of bringing repo markets onto centrally cleared platforms from a CCP perspective. The paper lists a set of key considerations that CCPs—and indirectly—policy makers could take into account when exploring the expansion of repo clearing services or opting for a repo clearing mandate. Aside from considerations pertaining to access modalities to repo clearing services, default management and market structure-related aspects are of key importance. Together, these factors ensure that the transition of repo transactions from a decentralized, uncleared set-up to central clearing is conducive to more resilient repo and ultimately government bond markets.

abstract_zh: 自2015年起，面对高住房市场压力的法国市镇被允许对第二套住房征收住房税附加费。采用合成双重差分设计，我们发现受处理市镇中申报的第二套住房数量显著下降，住房税收收入显著增加，但未发现房价下降的证据。基于住宅层面的转换微观数据，我们表明第二套住房表面上的减少大部分源于出于税收目的的策略性重新分类，而非实际居住状况的改变。

title: Political uncertainty, corruption, and corporate investment: evidence from India

authors: Rohit Thakur, Bhanu Singh, Amrinder Singh, Manoharan Kannadhasan
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study uses hand-collected data to investigate the impact of state-level political uncertainty and corruption on corporate investment in India. We use a panel of 1,666 firms with 16,869 firm-year observations from 2001 to 2022. We find that the interaction between political uncertainty and corruption negatively affects firm-level investments, and that firms close to political power face greater political uncertainty. These findings are consistent across multiple robustness checks. We further validate the results by employing a Difference-in-Differences (DID) framework and using the 2018 Prevention of Corruption (Amendment) Act as a quasi-natural experiment to check investment patterns. The strong anti-corruption measures helped alleviate the negative impact of political uncertainty and corruption. Overall, the study highlights the adverse effect of state-level political uncertainty and corruption on firm-level investments.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用手工收集的数据，考察了印度邦级政治不确定性与腐败对企业投资的影响。我们采用了一个包含2001年至2022年间1,666家企业、共16,869个企业-年度观测值的面板数据。研究发现，政治不确定性与腐败之间的交互作用对企业层面投资产生负面影响，且靠近政治权力的企业面临更高的政治不确定性。这些发现在多项稳健性检验中保持一致。我们进一步通过采用双重差分（DID）框架，并利用2018年《反腐败（修正）法案》作为准自然实验来验证投资模式，从而确认了上述结果。强有力的反腐败措施有助于缓解政治不确定性和腐败的负面影响。总体而言，本研究强调了邦级政治不确定性与腐败对企业层面投资的不利影响。

title: Angels, entrepreneurship, and employment dynamics: Evidence from investor accreditation rules
title_zh: 天使投资、创业与就业动态：来自投资者认证规则的证据

abstract: This paper examines the effects of a shock to angel finance on entrepreneurial activity. Using U.S. Census data, we estimate the state-level fraction of households that lost accreditation status from Dodd–Frank’s elimination of housing wealth in determining accreditation. A larger reduction in the pool of potential investors reduces angel investment, firm entry, and employment at small entrants. Employment increases at small and young incumbents, suggesting competitive effects. Though we document partial substitution, angel finance appears to complement other capital sources in the entrepreneurial ecosystem. Our paper offers insight on the impact of angel finance and where it matters most.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了天使融资冲击对创业活动的影响。利用美国人口普查数据，我们估算了因多德-弗兰克法案取消住房财富在认定合格投资者资格中的作用，而导致各州失去合格投资者身份的家庭比例。潜在投资者池的更大缩减减少了天使投资、企业进入以及小型新进入企业的就业。小型和年轻在位企业的就业增加，表明存在竞争效应。尽管我们记录了部分替代效应，但天使融资似乎与创业生态系统中的其他资本来源形成互补。本文为理解天使融资的影响及其最关键的作用领域提供了洞见。

abstract: This paper examines how global greenfield foreign direct investment (FDI) flows are evolving amid rising geoeconomic fragmentation. We use difference-in-differences and event study approaches to analyze changes in FDI around key bilateral inflection points. We find a decline in FDI from the US and broader Group of Seven Plus (G7+) into the PRC, concentrated in trade-exposed, efficiency-seeking sectors. Investment diversion—particularly from the PRC to Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) members and Latin America—is evident, but this growth was concentrated in less global value chain (GVC)-integrated activities, suggesting that GVC links may act as a constraint on investment relocation. These findings suggest that while tensions may be reshaping global investment, GVC dependencies are likely limiting firms’ ability to reallocate production at scale, making the “great reallocation” least evident where it was most expected.
abstract_zh: 我们系统梳理了1968年至2020年间美联储工作人员在公开材料中向联邦公开市场委员会提交的1265份替代情景分析。这些情景分析的频率和复杂程度持续提升，通常围绕基准预测构建一系列可能结果。我们构建了包含六大类别的分类体系：总需求、总供给、外部风险、金融状况、财政政策及预期变化。工作人员的风险定性评估与情景构成形成互补。通过将情景预测与实际结果对比发现，即便在数值预测存在偏差时，最精准的情景往往仍能预判重大宏观经济走势，这揭示了情景分析在央行风险管理中的价值与局限性。

title: An upwind scheme for continuous-time optimization with two endogenous state variables

abstract: I develop a novel upwind scheme to solve the Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman (HJB) equation with two endogenous state variables. The algorithm chooses the upwind direction that gives the largest Hamiltonian to numerically determine optimal policies over the full state space. The choice of upwind direction in each iteration is intuitive, and can be implemented without splitting asset drifts into multiple components. I compare optimal policy functions on a wealth grid produced by the upwind scheme with those obtained from the splitting scheme used in the literature, and find discrepancies of policy functions at the boundaries.
abstract_zh: 我开发了一种新颖的上风格式，用于求解具有两个内生状态变量的Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman（HJB）方程。该算法选择产生最大Hamiltonian的上风方向，以数值方式确定整个状态空间上的最优策略。每次迭代中上风方向的选择直观易懂，且无需将资产漂移分解为多个分量即可实现。我将上风格式在财富网格上生成的最优策略函数与文献中使用的分裂格式所得结果进行了比较，发现策略函数在边界处存在差异。

title: Inference on Buffer‐Stock Saving

abstract: ABSTRACT There is an ongoing debate about the buffer‐stock saving hypothesis. This paper develops a formal test of the hypothesis by examining the sub‐unity of the marginal propensity to consume out of permanent income (MPCP). Our test relies on a novel estimator of the average derivative of a nonparametric consumption model, using constructed measures of latent permanent income shocks that accommodate nonparametric income distributions. Following Li and Vuong (1998), we use a Kotlarski‐based approach to account for asymmetric errors, which is crucial for testing buffer‐stock behavior. Applied to the US Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID) data, our test rejects a unit MPCP, providing empirical support for buffer‐stock saving.
abstract_zh: 摘要 关于缓冲储备储蓄假说的争论仍在持续。本文通过检验永久收入边际消费倾向（MPCP）是否小于1，对该假说进行了正式检验。我们的检验依赖于一种非参数消费模型平均导数的创新估计方法，利用构建的潜在永久收入冲击度量，以适应非参数收入分布。遵循Li和Vuong（1998）的研究，我们采用基于Kotlarski的方法来处理非对称误差，这对于检验缓冲储备行为至关重要。应用于美国收入动态面板研究（PSID）数据后，我们的检验拒绝了MPCP等于1的假设，为缓冲储备储蓄提供了实证支持。

title: Information, prices and buyer entry
title_zh: 信息、价格与买方进入

authors: Mei Dong, Janet Hua Jiang, Ling Sun

abstract: Conventional wisdom suggests that information transparency about prices lowers prices and markups by intensifying seller competition. We show that, when buyer entry is endogenous, this relationship depends on the price measure under consideration. Information transparency may attract additional buyers and intensify demand-side competition, which can raise the price and the markup charged by sellers that compete for informed buyers. Yet, average posted and traded prices may fall because more sellers compete for informed buyers. Thus, information transparency can lower aggregate price indices while raising individual equilibrium prices and markups.
abstract_zh: 传统观点认为，价格信息透明通过加剧卖方竞争会降低价格和加成率。我们证明，当买方进入是内生的时候，这种关系取决于所考虑的价格度量。信息透明可能吸引更多买方并加剧需求侧竞争，这可能会提高争夺知情买方的卖方所收取的价格和加成率。然而，由于更多卖方争夺知情买方，平均标价和成交价可能下降。因此，信息透明可以降低总体价格指数，同时提高个体均衡价格和加成率。

title: The effort-maximizing move order in tullock contests
title_zh: 塔洛克竞赛中努力最大化的行动顺序

title_secondary: The effort-maximizing move order in tullock contests
authors: Lei Gao, Jingfeng Lu, Zhewei Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines effort-maximizing move orders in two-player Tullock contests across varying levels of contest accuracy and player asymmetries. Unlike prior work that favors strong-lead sequential formats in lottery contests, our analysis demonstrates that all three formats—strong-lead, weak-lead, and simultaneous—can be optimal in the general Tullock contests. Strong-lead contests are most effective in noisy environments, but lose their advantage as contest accuracy increases. Weak-lead contests may become optimal when the weaker player successfully preempts. Simultaneous-move contests tend to perform better as the players’ ability differences become less severe. Overall, the optimal contest design jointly depends on the contest accuracy levels and relative strengths of the contestants.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在两人Tullock竞赛中，随着竞赛精确度与选手不对称性的变化，何种移动顺序能最大化努力程度。与先前偏好于彩票竞赛中强者领先顺序格式的研究不同，我们的分析表明，在一般Tullock竞赛中，三种格式——强者领先、弱者领先及同时进行——均可能成为最优选择。在噪声环境中，强者领先竞赛最为有效，但随着竞赛精确度的提升，其优势逐渐减弱。当较弱选手成功抢占先机时，弱者领先竞赛可能成为最优。而随着选手能力差异减小，同时移动竞赛往往表现更佳。总体而言，最优竞赛设计取决于竞赛精确度水平及参赛者相对实力的共同作用。

title: Economic inequality and social mobility in preindustrial societies: What we know, what we don't (but should) know
title_zh: 前工业化社会的经济不平等与社会流动性：已知、未知与应知
title_primary: 前工业化社会的经济不平等与社会流动性：已知、未知与应知
title_secondary: Economic inequality and social mobility in preindustrial societies: What we know, what we don't (but should) know
official: 官方在线 2026-05-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In recent years economic inequality has become a major research topic in economic history. However, much remains to be done to complete our knowledge of long‐term distributive dynamics. This article highlights several promising avenues for future research, focusing on the preindustrial period. In particular, it identifies the main gaps that still need to be filled in reconstructions of wealth and income distributions; it argues for a closer interaction between scholars working on economic inequality and those working on historical gross domestic product (GDP); and it highlights socio‐economic mobility as a closely related, but much less explored, research area. Shifting the focus from inequality to mobility, and more generally considering how human agency helped shape the aggregate long‐term dynamics we observe, requires examining individual actors and their specific motivations more closely. This is especially true for the socio‐economic elites who, when faced with a perceived threat of status loss, could attempt to capture political institutions, thus securing their control over valuable public resources, whilst at the same time acting as ‘enemies of mobility’. The article also highlights how this kind of research speaks directly to current societal concerns.
abstract_zh: 近年来，经济不平等已成为经济史领域的重要研究课题。然而，关于长期分配动态的认知仍存在大量空白。本文聚焦前工业化时期，为未来研究指明了若干富有前景的方向。具体而言，本文识别了财富与收入分布重建中仍需填补的主要空白；主张研究经济不平等与历史国内生产总值（GDP）的学者应加强互动；并强调社会经济流动性是一个密切相关但研究尚不充分的领域。将研究重心从不平等转向流动性，并更广泛地思考人类能动性如何塑造我们所观察到的长期宏观动态，需要更深入地审视个体行为者及其特定动机。这一点对社会经济精英尤为关键——当面临地位丧失的威胁时，他们可能试图捕获政治制度以维持对公共资源的控制，同时充当"流动性的敌人"。本文还揭示了此类研究如何直接回应当前的社会关切。

title: A model of China’s economic vertical structure
title_zh: 中国经济垂直结构模型
title_primary: 中国经济垂直结构模型
title_secondary: A model of China’s economic vertical structure
authors: Xi Li, Xuewen Liu, Zhikun Lu, Yong Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-13 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We document a prominent yet underappreciated feature of the post-2000 Chinese economy: a vertical structure in which key upstream industries are dominated by state-owned enterprises (SOEs), while downstream industries are largely open to private competition. We develop a general-equilibrium model to analyze how this vertical structure—interacting with industrialization, globalization, and labor abundance—has shaped the Chinese economy. The framework offers new insights into SOE profitability, structural change, resource misallocation, and economic reform. First, upstream SOEs become more profitable as downstream private firms raise their productivity and face greater external demand during industrialization and globalization, helping explain the unprecedented prosperity of SOEs between 2002 and 2007. Second, reducing upstream market power would facilitate labor reallocation from agriculture to non-agricultural sectors, raising GDP and aggregate welfare. Third, preferential credit subsidies to SOEs can improve welfare by alleviating upstream under-supply; consequently, removing these subsidies without dismantling SOE monopoly power could reduce welfare. Quantitative analyses using firm-level data support the theoretical findings. We further show that this vertical structure can arise endogenously as an equilibrium outcome.
abstract_zh: 我们记录了中国2000年后经济中一个显著但未得到充分认识的特征：一种纵向结构，其中关键上游行业由国有企业主导，而下游行业则基本向私营竞争开放。我们构建了一个一般均衡模型，分析这种纵向结构——与工业化、全球化和劳动力充裕相互作用——如何塑造了中国经济。该框架为国有企业盈利能力、结构变迁、资源错配和经济改革提供了新的见解。首先，随着下游私营企业提高生产率并在工业化和全球化过程中面临更大的外部需求，上游国有企业变得更加盈利，这有助于解释2002年至2007年间国有企业前所未有的繁荣。其次，减少上游市场势力将促进劳动力从农业向非农业部门重新配置，从而提高GDP和总体福利。第三，对国有企业的优惠信贷补贴可以通过缓解上游供给不足来改善福利；因此，在不瓦解国有企业垄断势力的情况下取消这些补贴可能会降低福利。基于企业层面数据的定量分析支持了理论发现。我们进一步表明，这种纵向结构可以作为均衡结果内生地出现。

abstract: What explains wealth and portfolio differences between black and white Americans? We find that disparities in economic factors explain portfolios well, but only partly explain the wealth gap. In a dynamic setting, economic factors often change optimal saving rates in ways that offset their effects on income and returns. Consequently, their net wealth effect is often limited, making the wealth gap harder to explain. We estimate that differences in income levels, income risk, family structures, mortality, health expenditures, property taxes, mortgage rates, and asset returns explain half of the differential between the racial wealth gap and the racial income gap.
abstract_zh: 什么因素导致了美国黑人与白人之间的财富和投资组合差异？我们发现，经济因素的差异能够较好地解释投资组合差异，但只能部分解释财富差距。在动态环境中，经济因素常常会改变最优储蓄率，从而抵消其对收入和回报的影响。因此，这些因素的净财富效应往往有限，使得财富差距更难以解释。我们估算，收入水平、收入风险、家庭结构、死亡率、医疗支出、房产税、抵押贷款利率以及资产回报率的差异，解释了种族财富差距与种族收入差距之间差异的一半。

abstract: Exploiting a 1960s government trial in Copenhagen, we study the long-run effects of preventive health care for toddlers. We combine administrative data with handwritten nurse records to document universal treatment take-up. Treated children enjoy a five percent of a standard deviation increase in a good adult health index. While initial trial cohorts experience positive health and labour market impacts, those are absent for the final cohorts. Impacts are largest for children with initial health disadvantage and females, and we identify childhood health improvements as a core mechanism. The heterogeneity of trial effects across individuals’ initial health status and cohorts documents that universal toddler care can alleviate health inequalities at low costs, and that the counterfactual policy environment matters.
abstract_zh: 利用20世纪60年代在哥本哈根开展的一项政府试验，我们研究了幼儿预防性医疗保健的长期影响。我们将行政数据与手写护士记录相结合，记录了普遍的治疗接受情况。接受治疗的儿童在成年健康综合指数上提高了0.05个标准差。尽管最初的试验队列在健康和劳动力市场方面产生了积极影响，但最终队列并未观察到这些影响。对于初始健康状况较差的儿童和女性，影响最为显著，并且我们确定儿童期健康状况改善是核心机制。试验效果因个体初始健康状况和队列而异，这表明普遍的幼儿保健能够以低成本缓解健康不平等，且反事实政策环境至关重要。

abstract: We analyze a setting in which physicians, who differ in their degree of altruism, first exert diagnostic effort before deciding whether to administer a test to determine the most appropriate treatment. Diagnostic effort yields an imperfect private signal of the patient's type, whereas the test provides a more accurate assessment. Absent corrective transfers, physicians exert too little diagnostic effort and may rely excessively on testing. When altruism is either homogeneous or observable, the first-best allocation can be decentralized through a payment scheme consisting of (i) a pay-for-performance (P4P) component, based on the proportion of correctly treated patients, to induce the optimal diagnostic effort and (ii) a fixed component to ensure both the optimal testing decision and physician participation. When altruism is heterogeneous and privately known to physicians, the two-part tariff that decentralizes the first-best is no longer incentive compatible. The optimal contract is pooling rather than separating, an instance of nonresponsiveness. Its uniform P4P component induces more altruistic physicians to exert higher diagnostic effort, while the fixed component must be conditioned on diagnostic test costs to promote optimal testing decisions.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了一个情境，其中利他主义程度不同的医生，首先付出诊断努力，然后决定是否进行测试以确定最合适的治疗方案。诊断努力产生关于患者类型的不完美私人信号，而测试则提供更准确的评估。在没有纠正性转移支付的情况下，医生付出的诊断努力过少，并可能过度依赖测试。当利他主义是同质的或可观察时，通过一种支付方案可以实现最优配置的分散化，该方案包括：（i）基于正确治疗患者比例的按绩效付费（P4P）组成部分，以诱导最优诊断努力；（ii）固定组成部分，以确保最优测试决策和医生参与。当利他主义是异质的且为医生私人所知时，分散化最优配置的两部定价不再具有激励相容性。最优合同是混同而非分离，这是非响应性的一个实例。其统一的P4P组成部分促使更具利他主义的医生付出更高的诊断努力，而固定组成部分则必须根据诊断测试成本进行调整，以促进最优测试决策。

title: Likelihood specification in simultaneous equation models for discrete data

title_secondary: Likelihood specification in simultaneous equation models for discrete data

abstract: In this article, we examine the foundations of a rich and diverse literature in economics and derive the likelihood function of simultaneous equation models for discrete data as the invariant distribution of a suitably specified Markov process. This formulation offers a well-defined reduced form of the model and dispenses with the need for controversial recursivity requirements and ad hoc indeterminacy rules. The derivation resolves puzzling paradoxes highlighted in earlier work and shows that the likelihood is unique, proper, coherent, complete, and theoretically grounded in conditional distribution modeling – a framework that has yet to be popularized in economics. We note possible extensions and relevant links with other models, comment on computational issues, and implement the methodology in three empirical applications involving female labor force participation, the interactions between health and wealth, and the interplay between banks’ lending practices and their reliance on assistance from the lender of last resort during the Great Depression.
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们探讨了经济学中一个丰富且多元文献的基础，并推导了离散数据联立方程模型的似然函数，将其视为一个适当设定的马尔可夫过程的不变分布。这一表述为模型提供了一个明确的简化形式，并免除了对有争议的递归性要求和临时性不确定性规则的需求。该推导解决了早期研究中突出的令人困惑的悖论，并表明似然函数是唯一的、恰当的、连贯的、完整的，并且在理论上基于条件分布建模——这一框架在经济学中尚未普及。我们指出了可能的扩展方向及与其他模型的相关联系，讨论了计算问题，并在三个实证应用中实施了该方法，涉及女性劳动力参与、健康与财富之间的相互作用，以及大萧条期间银行贷款行为与对最后贷款人援助依赖之间的互动。

abstract: This study examines the effectiveness of Digital Financial Inclusion (DFI) in alleviating the vulnerability of expected poverty (VEP) among rural households in China by utilizing data from the China Family Panel Studies (CFPS) from 2012 to 2020. The results demonstrate a mechanism that DFI significantly reduces VEP among rural households by stimulating entrepreneurial activities. However, this mechanism exhibits a distinct ‘digital divide’ where households below the poverty line of $1.90 per day fail to utilize DFI to mitigate their VEP status, due to insufficient digital literacy, lower risk tolerance, and higher risk aversion. By analysing the marginal effects of control variables such as the head of household’s occupation, family size, and healthcare, this study provides valuable conclusions and additional empirical evidence to eliminate rural vulnerability. This study carries significant implications for extending the benefits of deepened DFI reforms to greater numbers of impoverished households.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用2012年至2020年中国家庭追踪调查（CFPS）数据，探讨了数字普惠金融（DFI）在缓解中国农村家庭预期贫困脆弱性（VEP）方面的有效性。研究结果显示，DFI通过激发创业活动显著降低了农村家庭的VEP，但这一机制呈现出明显的“数字鸿沟”现象：日均收入低于1.90美元贫困线的家庭，因数字素养不足、风险承受能力较低及风险规避倾向较高，未能利用DFI来缓解其VEP状况。通过分析户主职业、家庭规模及医疗保障等控制变量的边际效应，本研究为消除农村脆弱性提供了有价值的结论及额外的实证证据。本研究对于将深化DFI改革的红利惠及更多贫困家庭具有重要启示意义。

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2023-02-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates the local average treatment effect (LATE) with high-dimensional covariates, irrespective of the strength of identification. We propose a novel test statistic for the high-dimensional LATE and demonstrate that our test has uniformly correct asymptotic size. By employing the double/debiased machine learning method for nuisance parameter estimation, we develop easy-to-implement algorithms for inference and confidence interval calculation of the high-dimensional LATE. Simulations indicate that our test is robust against both weak identification and high dimensionality concerning size control and power performance, outperforming other conventional tests. Applying the proposed method to railroad and population data to study the effect of railroad access on urban population growth, we observe that our methodology yields point estimates for the railroad access coefficients that are smaller in magnitude and confidence intervals that are by 49% to 92% shorter depending on specifications, when compared to the conventional results.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种在高维协变量存在下，无论识别强度如何，对局部平均处理效应（LATE）进行推断的方法。我们构建了一个正交化的安德森-鲁宾检验统计量，该统计量能保持均匀有效的渐近规模。通过反转该检验统计量并采用双重/去偏机器学习方法，我们提供了一种易于实现的算法来推断高维LATE。模拟结果表明，在弱识别和高维性条件下，我们的检验在规模控制方面优于传统替代方法。将所提方法应用于铁路与人口数据以研究铁路通达对城市人口增长的影响时，我们观察到比传统方法更宽的置信区间。
